<thought>We need to find a retrosynthetic template that matches the target molecule and corresponds to a cycloaddition where a ketone and a C≡C triple bond are lost, a C‑C bond is formed and a C‑O bond is broken. Using the search tool with these functional group criteria should return suitable templates, after which we can verify which one matches the molecule.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketone", "C-C triple bond"],
    "functional_groups_formed": null,
    "bonds_formed": ["6-6"],
    "bonds_broken": ["6-8"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
